Definition: Whether the system enables individuals to authenticate themselves or their documents digitally through electronic verification
Comments: No operational digital authentication function exists. The World Bank (2024) explicitly states Equatorial Guinea must 'establish an operational trust framework for digital authentication.' The biometric chip on the national ID card has no practical use. No e-signature platform has been implemented despite a 2017 framework.

revision_notes: A light check surfaced a clearly authoritative source (World Bank, Equatorial Guinea Digital Economy Country Diagnostic, June 2024), so this row was escalated from the fast path to a full verification. The report explicitly states the country must still establish an operational trust framework for digital authentication and has not implemented an e-signature platform. This supports a definite 'No' rather than 'Unknown'. Value code changed from 0 to 1.
revised_comments: No operational digital authentication function exists in Equatorial Guinea. The World Bank's Digital Economy Country Diagnostic (2024) finds that the country still needs to strengthen its foundational identification system and establish an operational trust framework for digital authentication, and that an e-signature platform (planned since 2017) has not been implemented. The biometric chip embedded in the national identity card is not used for any electronic verification purpose.

Definition: Whether authentication is possible through a centralized government portal or digital gateway
Comments: No government portal authentication via digital ID exists. The CNEDOGE website (launched 2022) allows citizens to register document requests online but requires physical presence for completion. No digital authentication gateway or unified government portal using digital ID is operational.

Definition: Whether individuals can view their data held in the ID database and see how it has been accessed
Comments: No evidence of a mechanism for individuals to view or access their own identity data digitally. The data protection law (Law No. 1/2016) grants rights of access and rectification but no digital portal for data viewing exists. The DPA is not operational.

Definition: Whether credential is accepted or mandatory for accessing public healthcare services
Comments: No evidence found of the national ID system being formally integrated with healthcare access in Equatorial Guinea. The civil registry (birth registration) has some linkage with health facilities for birth notifications, but no systematic health-ID integration program is documented.

Definition: Whether ID system undergoes regular security audits, penetration testing, or vulnerability assessments
Comments: No evidence of formal security reviews of the digital ID system. The World Bank (2024) recommends conducting a cybersecurity maturity assessment for Equatorial Guinea. The country ranked 180th out of 181 countries on the ITU Global Cybersecurity Index 2020. No published security audits of CNEDOGE or the ID system found.
